# Komorebi Interiors — full site content

## Key facts
- Phone: +1 431 830 0002
- Email: info@komorebiinteriors.ca
- Address: Toronto, ON, CA
- Service area: Toronto; Greater Toronto Area
- Hours: Mon–Fri, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Komorebi (木漏れ日) is a Japanese word for sunlight filtering through leaves.
- Services: elite event décor (corporate events, weddings, anniversaries, engagements, VIP dinners, galas, baptisms, convocations and funerals or memorials) and interior décor.
- Every setup is customised to the occasion, venue and client; designs are never copied from a catalogue.

## About Us
URL: https://komorebiinteriors.ca/about-us

We design event experiences with creative décor, personal styling and close attention to detail, for gatherings of every size.
### Creating unforgettable celebrations with style and elegance.
### Named for the light between leaves.
To create memorable celebrations through creativity, elegance and personalised décor, with care for the design, the service and every small detail.
### Our mission
To be a trusted name in event décor, known for original designs, skilled craftsmanship and experiences guests remember.
### Our vision
We value skilled artisans, local jobs, safe working conditions and ethical, responsibly sourced materials.
### Social wellness
### Mission, vision and values.
Tell us about the occasion and we'll set up a first conversation.
